node.title: HGE4 exact-ratio tower orbit compiler
node.statement: Primitive top shift-pair scaling orbits split bijectively by their exact dyadic ratio subgroup: O_h^prim(n,p)=sum_(m|n,m>=2h) E_h^prim(m,p), and each exact-level orbit has h left-anchored presentations. Therefore the levelwise estimate sum_(h=4)^floor(m/2) E_h^prim(m,p)<=(21/2)m^2 for every m|n sums geometrically to less than 14n^2 and implies HGE4. Exact levels are projected by the non-full near-square scheme with S(1)=a, V_r=1, and V_(r-1)!=1. The levelwise estimate itself is not proved.
